# v0.1.16 preview

This artifact is a preview. It is not a claim of GitHub Actions
equivalence.

The version string is 0.1.16. The capability version is 12.

The poller retries once with a distinct, stable key when a repeated
submission returns an earlier storage-full setup refusal.
`actions/upload-artifact` accepts and records `retention-days` as an
integer from 1 to 90. The worker does not enforce that value as an
artifact expiration policy.

Resource-scheduling decision proposals and a private managed-capacity
cost and design study are included. These remain proposals, without
an implemented scheduler or managed service.

The experimental GitHub runner registration and webhook-intake module
is disabled by default. `ROOKRUNNER_EXPERIMENTAL_GITHUB_RUNNERS=1`
opts in to the Python API prototype. It has no CLI command or HTTP
listener and does not execute jobs.

CI also checks documentation for links to unpublished packages and dead
external links.

The wheel and the source tarball can be built from this tree. They
are not published. This change does not create a tag.

The project license is the MIT License.

The App private key is not in the artifact.
